reviews.title: Scam and unauthorized charges
reviews.text: I paid for 30.38 per month for 2 months then tried to cancel and was offered 14.99 per YEAR!!! Thieves! After I cancelled I still got multiple unauthorized charges. I’m still fighting to get refunded.

reviews.title: Inaccuracies
reviews.text: No AI app is going to be 100% accurate I know that, but i would expect it to be accurate when I input the macros myself, even when i go through the long process of doing this on my own, the app does not add up the macros correctly sometimes and instead of letting me manually change it I have to amend my problem using the buggy AI. I paid for the year so I am going to use it for that long but then will switch to a different tracker.

reviews.title: App
reviews.text: Paid for a yearly subscription, two months in the app keeps crashing and I can’t even use it. Apple support said it’s not my phone.

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: The app doesn’t accurately log correct macros. When I take a pic of the packaging it will log 0cals/macs. When I scan the barcode it will log the macs for the whole package. If it’s not doing either of those things it will come up with a “food not detected” prompt. You’re going to spend more time redoing the logging than actually enjoying the process of logging your meals. I will be looking elsewhere for a macro tracker.

reviews.text: Agreed to $6.93 for 3 month trial then subscription would be charged . I got email almost immediately they were going to charge me the subscription rate in 7 days. I don't like dishonesty. I emailed immediately to say they were not truthful and I wanted the $6.93 back. It's not the money it's the principle.  Ashley from support said no refund even after I explained what the company did. Not cool at all. How many others paid money for nothing?

reviews.title: App Does Not Work
reviews.text: App flat out does not work. I’d like my subscription back. All I get is a screen that says welcome to Lean and a button that doesn’t function. Takes you nowhere. I was able to use the app for a day and now I feel scammed. I’ve tried to reach out to the Lean “contact us” and the button to submit doesn’t even work. This all seems very sketchy.

reviews.title: Money Grab company.
reviews.text: Money grab company. Downloaded it got the free trial. Forgot about it after they charged my account. Never used the app never logged any food or workouts nothing. Simply canceled subscription and asked for a refund cause I won’t be using the app. They said no. I guess a free $40 for another money grab health/fitness app.

reviews.title: Poor Customer Service
reviews.text: I had an issue with billing and was charged an unexpected fee. When I contacted them about it I was basically referred to their ’no refund policy’. When I asked for more details and a confirmation that there would be no additional charges they basically ghosted me. I sent two separate correspondences, both of which were ignored. I find this extremely unprofessional. Buyer beware!

reviews.title: Avoid this TERRIBLE app
reviews.text: There is no way to change a serving size when you scan your food. So even when you eat half of a recommended serving, it records the entire serving on the log. There are much better apps out there. Even though I was suppose to get three free days they charged for a year.

reviews.title: Zero stars
reviews.text:
This app is extremely disappointing. None of the features that were advertised are actually available. The interface is confusing, poorly designed, and there is no clear way to cancel the subscription anywhere in the app, which feels intentional.
Charging users for something that does not deliver what was promised is misleading and unacceptable. This feels like a scam rather than a legitimate service.
I do not recommend this app at all. Save your money and your time. I will be warning others so they don’t fall into the same situation.

reviews.title: No functioning or support
reviews.text: Terrible app, once you start actually trying to progress your tracking it won’t work. Non of your numbers change.

reviews.title: Accuracy is questionable
reviews.text: Whenever I try putting twice as much of something in a bowl, to test the quantitation, the macros do not scale Properly at all. All the reported values of scanned food are probably inaccurate,potentially by a lot. The barcode scanning doesn't recognize a lot of products. Macros for Any meal with multiple ingredients can't be accurately quantified unless you do it along the way ingredient by ingredient, defeating the app's entire purpose.

reviews.title: App doesn’t work
reviews.text: I downloaded the app and started using it. When I went back to update info the app would just close out. I shut my phone off and back on, still didn’t work. I deleted the app and started all over again and it just kicks me out of the app and keeps wanting me to start over. I subscribed for one year and I am out that money.

reviews.title: Lacking in key features
reviews.text: Nice idea but sadly lacking in features. Food database is very poor, the barcode scanning feature doesn’t seem to work and integration with fitness apps is completely lacking. More work to do on this app and so cannot recommend this I’m afraid.
